name: Anero
source:
Attribute: Aquamarine

Somewhat cold in character. The calm type that doesn't meddle much with others.
Used to run a stand on the beach as a part-time job. [spoiler]Even though she's a witch, she can't use magic.[/spoiler]

[Based off description from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/janis/magicalpalette/]Janis official website[/url]]
